description: This Java class implements validation logic for progressive loan rescheduling requests within the Fineract platform, including validation for create, approve, and reject actions, and checks for various rescheduling parameters and constraints.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanRescheduleRequestDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for handling validation logic related to progressive loan rescheduling requests, including create, approve, and reject actions.

methods.name: validateForCreateAction
methods.description: Validates the data for creating a new loan reschedule request, including parameters like reschedule date, interest rate, and extra terms.

methods.name: validateAdjustDueDateChange
methods.description: Validates the adjustment of the due date during rescheduling, ensuring the loan is active and no overdue charges exist.

methods.name: validateInterestRate
methods.description: Validates interest rate changes, including date constraints and loan status.

methods.name: validateExtraTerms
methods.description: Validates the extra terms parameter, ensuring the loan is active and within allowed limits.

methods.name: validateExtraTermsParam
methods.description: Extracts and validates the extra terms parameter from JSON input.

methods.name: validateReschedulingInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the specified installment exists for rescheduling.

methods.name: validateUnsupportedParams
methods.description: Ensures unsupported parameters are not included in the request.

methods.name: validateForApproveAction
methods.description: Validates the approval of a reschedule request, including date, status, and related installment.

methods.name: validateInterestRateChangeRescheduleFromDate
methods.description: Checks if an interest rate change for the given date already exists.

methods.name: validateInterestRateParam
methods.description: Extracts and validates the interest rate parameter from JSON input.
